title: Terminal snapshot fan-out RSS spikes
intent: Attributing startup heap growth in isolated HOME (no-client control + backtrace sampling)
progress_summary: Baseline in isolated HOME: RSS 74.8 MB -> 2,243 MB, still rising; snapshot/repair counters stayed 0 and terminal output JSON totalled 384 bytes. Heap growth starts at project open (17:20:10), before any WS client connects, so the Issue's snapshot-fan-out hypothesis does not explain it. Running a no-client control and a backtrace-sampling build to find the allocation site.
